name: Jessy Ribordy
bio: A founding member and the voice of Falling Up from the start in 2001. Beyond lead vocals, Jessy Ribordy played guitar, keyboards and programming across every album from Crashings to the 2015 self-titled record. When Falling Up's run ended in 2024, Jessy carried on fronting The Chilling Alpine Adventure, now on lead vocals and bass.

name: Daniel Elder
bio: Joined Falling Up on guitar and backing vocals in 2008, debuting on Fangs! and staying through the band's final records. Daniel Elder moved over to The Chilling Alpine Adventure on guitar in 2024.

name: Nick Lambert
bio: Added a guitar to Falling Up's lineup in 2012, in time for Hours and the run of EPs that followed. Nick Lambert stayed through 2024 and continues on guitar in The Chilling Alpine Adventure.

name: Jordan Wood
bio: The newest face in the crew: Jordan Wood joined The Chilling Alpine Adventure on drums in 2024 and played on the band's self-titled debut.

name: Jeremy Miller
bio: A founding member who held down bass guitar, plus keyboards, for Falling Up's entire run from 2001 to 2024 — every studio album and EP from Crashings to the self-titled record.

name: Josh Shroy
bio: A founding member and Falling Up's drummer and percussionist for the band's full run, 2001 to 2024, playing on every studio album and EP.

name: Tom Cox
bio: A founding member who played guitar and sang backing vocals on Falling Up's first two albums, Crashings and Dawn Escapes, before leaving in 2005.

name: Joe Kisselburgh
bio: A founding member on guitar and backing vocals. Joe Kisselburgh played on Crashings and Dawn Escapes and left in August 2006, just ahead of Exit Lights.

name: Andrew Wadlow
bio: A founding member who handled turntables, keyboards and programming in Falling Up's earliest days, from 2001 to 2003, before the band's first album was released.

name: Michael Humphrey
bio: Took over turntables, keyboards and programming from 2003 to 2005, adding electronic texture to Crashings and Dawn Escapes.

name: Micah Sannan
bio: Played guitar with Falling Up from 2005 to 2007, through the Exit Lights and Captiva era.

name: Adam Taylor
bio: Covered keyboards, programming and backing vocals from 2005 to 2007, playing on Exit Lights and Captiva.

name: Daniel Huddleston
bio: A touring guitarist who filled out Falling Up's live lineup from 2007 to 2010.
